recognize_zh: Masson 三色染色中，紅色的骨小樑表面貼著一層藍色膠原（paratrabecular collagen），並延伸至骨髓腔成為大量藍紫色膠原纖維與梭形細胞，呈串流狀排列，造血細胞稀少，代表原發性骨髓纖維化的膠原纖維化。
features: Bony trabecula (red) with lamellar lines and osteocyte lacunae at upper left
Band of blue-staining collagen apposed to the trabecular surface (paratrabecular collagen deposition)
Marrow space replaced by dense blue-purple collagen fibers with elongated spindle cells in streaming fascicles
Marked paucity of recognizable hematopoietic cells and fat
Staining colors are somewhat intense and color-shifted, limiting fine assessment
describe_en: Masson trichrome-stained bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a bony trabecula with a band of blue-staining collagen apposed to its surface, extending into an intertrabecular space that is replaced by dense collagen fibers and spindled stromal cells arranged in streaming fascicles. Recognizable hematopoietic elements and fat are markedly reduced. Findings indicate collagen fibrosis with paratrabecular apposition, corresponding to a high grade of marrow fibrosis (collagen grade 2-3 / MF-3 range with reticulin correlation), consistent with the overt fibrotic stage of primary myelofibrosis in the clinical context; the image color balance limits precise grading.

ddx.vs: Desmoplastic metastases contain cohesive keratin-positive epithelial nests within the collagen, which should be sought on H&E and IHC.
Therapy-related fibrosis occurs in a hypocellular marrow without atypical clustered megakaryocytes and is supported by treatment history.
Hyperparathyroidism produces peritrabecular fibrosis with increased osteoclasts and dissecting resorption, but without a myeloproliferative megakaryocytic proliferation.
Mastocytosis shows paratrabecular spindled mast cell aggregates with eosinophils that are CD117/tryptase positive.
